# Contributing

Please report any issues you encounter through GitHub Issues. Include application
version, Windows version, location, controls, steps, expected and actual results.
For graphics or audio, include the relevant frontend settings. Review screenshots
and diagnostic logs for private information before attaching them.

Do not upload ROMs, game assets, personal settings, saves or snapshots.
Follow BUILDING.md to build. Windows CI verifies portability, source integrity,
the Release build and its Windows dependencies without a ROM. It does not certify
gameplay. Keep changes focused and preserve notices. See SECURITY.md for private
vulnerability reporting.
